history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A close-up, low-angle selfie of a young East Asian woman with dark, straight hair and bangs. She is wearing a white t-shirt. Her right hand is raised, and her thumb and index finger are touching to form a heart shape gesture near her cheek. Her eyes are dark brown and looking directly at the camera. Her lips are slightly parted and appear to have a reddish tint. The background is softly blurred, with hints of pink and yellow on the left and what looks like a dark red, possibly wooden, surface on the bottom left. The lighting is soft and diffused, illuminating her face from the front, creating a gentle glow. The overall mood is sweet, cute, and intimate, with a hint of playfulness due to the hand gesture. The color palette is dominated by soft skin tones, dark hair, white clothing, and subtle background colors. The image has a slightly grainy texture, suggesting it might have been taken with a mobile phone camera in a less-than-ideal lighting condition, but this adds to its candid and personal feel.
